status: Prepared locally; all new auth methods are disabled until configured and verified

liveConfigurationEvidence.source: Root agent read-only inspection of the exact production Supabase project UI during this task

releaseFlags.VITE_AUTH_EMAIL_CODE_ENABLED: Default false. Set exactly true only after the Magic Link template includes Token and production code delivery/verification is tested. It then becomes the default for sign-in and registration; password remains optional.
releaseFlags.VITE_AUTH_GOOGLE_ENABLED: Default false. Set exactly true only after Google OAuth is configured in Supabase and a production round trip succeeds.
releaseFlags.VITE_AUTH_APPLE_ENABLED: Default false. Set exactly true only after Apple OAuth is configured in Supabase and a production round trip succeeds.
releaseFlags.buildBehavior: VITE_* flags are build-time public configuration. Changing them requires a new frontend build. No provider secret belongs in VITE_* values.

emailCodeActivation.destination: Supabase Authentication > Email Templates > Magic Link
emailCodeActivation.subject: Your 10BottleValue sign-in code
emailCodeActivation.preserves: The ConfirmationURL link remains available for existing clients. The signup confirmation template already contains Token and is not replaced.
acceptance: An authorized project operator saves the Magic Link template with both {{ .Token }} and {{ .ConfirmationURL }}.
A controlled real email receives a six-digit code, and verification produces a confirmed Supabase session.
Existing-account sign-in, new-account registration, invalid/expired code, resend cooldown and optional password are checked.
The code flow returns to the preserved cart and still requires checkout details and purchaser confirmations.

oauthActivation.redirectBehavior: The application computes this fixed path on the current site origin; that exact origin and URL must be explicitly allowed in Supabase. Do not enable social login on an unapproved preview origin.
google: Configure a Google Cloud Web application OAuth client with the intended audience and standard openid, email and profile scopes.
Add the production website origin and the exact Supabase project /auth/v1/callback URL to the appropriate Google allowlists.
Store the Google client ID and secret in the Supabase Google provider configuration, then enable the provider.
apple: Configure an Apple Developer App ID, associated Services ID, web domain and Supabase callback URL.
Configure the Apple provider in Supabase using the appropriate client ID and secret. Rotate the web OAuth secret at least every six months.
Apple OAuth does not provide a full name; retain the existing shipping/profile fields. Do not merge different email identities by name.
returnSafety: The current Supabase browser client uses implicit flow. Only a marked implicit callback with credentials, a valid local intent, successful SDK initialization and a confirmed session can resume checkout.
A cancelled, expired or failed provider return cannot resume using an older preserved Supabase session. Password recovery takes precedence.
Temporary return intent expires after 15 minutes and stores only product selectors, quantities and an account/cart destination. It stores no contact fields, tokens, prices or payment state.
Restored products are resolved and priced from the current catalog. No payment provider request is started automatically.
acceptance: Complete a real production sign-in for each enabled provider with the approved callback URL.
Check existing same-email accounts, new accounts, cancellation/back, provider error and checkout return.
Verify account cart hydration completes before stored cart writes are enabled.

validation.result: 28 tests passed before final combined release verification
validation.limitations: No production email was sent, no provider round trip was performed, no Supabase setting was changed and no deployment was performed by this subtask.
